items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: I got a friend right now in Kansas City who's still tendin' bar. His name's Jesse Fisher. We call him Kingfish.

ctx.x: So bartending was just as popular a profession during Prohibition as it was when drinking was legal?

Oh, yeah. Yes, indeed. I got a friend right now in Kansas City who's still tendin' bar. His name's Jesse Fisher. We call him Kingfish. I saw him about four...five years ago when I was there. He was tendin' bar aroun'...he's the one who learned me how to tend bar. 'Course, wasn't much to it. You hadda know the different whiskeys--the red and the white--sell soda pop, draw beer. And they had a big time [ ] the name bartender. He mixed all the different drinks, so when he would be mixing drinks, I would watch him.…
